messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate (us-east-1 gateway). 5xx spike started 00:00:40 ago, ~18% error rate. auto-scale triggered.

alice_oncall: Ack. Paging oncall. I'm on it — creating thread.

brian_runtime: I'm looking. Any segfaults in runtimes?

cindy_sre: I'm pulling host logs now, checking OOM and kernel reports.

dave_support: Support seeing a dozen customer error reports for batch requests. IDs: cust-804, cust-912, cust-1023. Customers running long-context chat.

eve_cs: I'll draft a short customer note if we can estimate ETA. Holding until we know cause.

brian_runtime: quick snapshot: model-runner processes in us-east-1 are restarting with SIGSEGV and some OOM kills on nodes gpu-a*-2. Repro on smaller traces: KV cache growth spikes then segfault.

cindy_sre: kernel log: 
```
Mar 17 14:01:02 gpu-a3-2 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 4578 (model-runner) score 985 or sacrifice child
Mar 17 14:01:02 gpu-a3-2 kernel: model-runner invoked oom-killer: gfp_mask=0x241da, order=0, oom_score_adj=0
```

alice_oncall: Good find. Is this a memory leak or bad batch size regression? Any recent rollout?

brian_runtime: There was a quant-kernel experiment rolled to 5% earlier today on the same pool. Trying to check if rollout correlated with spike. Can we roll that back quickly?

cindy_sre: I can cordon and drain affected nodes to stop new pods landing. Meanwhile we can scale up unaffected pool.

dave_support: Customer impact: measured 12% of requests failing for top 10 customers. Latency also increased for others. Ticketing queue filling.

eve_cs: I'll send an initial note: "We're investigating increased errors in us-east. Attempts may get 502/504. We're working to mitigate and will follow up." Confirm before sending?

alice_oncall: Send that, add we expect an update in 15 minutes.

brian_runtime: Mitigation plan: 1) rollback quant-kernel experiment -> `deployctl rollback kernel-experiment --env us-east` 2) enable fallback routing for /v1/generate to `small-llama-v1-quant` -> `router apply --route /v1/generate --fallback small-llama-v1-quant --region us-east` 3) restart model-runner pods after rollback. Doing step 1 now.

brian_runtime: step1 done: rollback triggered, confirmed no new rollout tasks. Monitoring.

cindy_sre: I'm scaling up dedicated pool: `k scale deploy/model-runner-dedicated-us-east --replicas=8` and cordoning gpu-a3-2.

brian_runtime: Enabling fallback routing now.

incident-bot: ACTION: fallback route updated for /v1/generate (us-east) -> small-llama-v1-quant. Old traffic will gradually shift (5 min).

dave_support: We're routing affected customers to fallback via a support toggle for immediate relief for cust-804 and cust-912 — those are okay to opt in.

eve_cs: Sent initial customer note.

brian_runtime: Restarting model-runner pods on drained nodes: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-runner-us-east -n inference --grace-period=30`

cindy_sre: Restart completions coming in, new pods on clean nodes. Memory usage looks back to baseline on new pods. No segfaults observed in the last 2 minutes.

alice_oncall: Error rate dropped to ~2% now, latency normalizing. Good.

frank_product: Any feature-level impact? Are function calls or tool-calling requests affected differently? We need to triage if regressions hit structured outputs.

brian_runtime: Early signal: tool calls had higher amplification due to larger KV cache usage. Fallback model reduces cache size. We'll capture a reproducible trace to root cause the kernel-level crash.

cindy_sre: I'm leaving nodes cordoned for now; will uncordon after 1h if stable.

eve_cs: Customer comms updated with mitigation and ETA for postmortem.

dave_support: I'll keep priority tickets open and notify customers who opted out of fallback.

alice_oncall: Handoff to post-incident team: brian, cindy, frank to own RCA. I'll mark incident as mitigated and escalate to SEV-2 with follow-up.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Mitigated -> error rate reduced from 18% to 2%. Postmortem requested. Tags: runtime, oom, segfault, gateway-5xx, routing-fallback.

brian_runtime: Adding logs and heap profiles to the incident doc. Will schedule a root cause deep-dive in 24h.

cindy_sre: Note for postmortem: check kernel release differences on affected nodes and the quant-kernel binary ABI.

alice_oncall: Thanks team. Closing live channel in 10m, handoff notes to ops-runbook. :white_check_mark:
